scene_summary: A quiet expressionist street plate: a vast cyan sky-screen opens the left side, while a cream vertical marquee slab, black gutter, brick spine apertures, and a tilted yellow pixel sign create the source-bearing edge system on the right. The road seam and tiny sky fleck give small findable gestures inside the broad field.
usable_surfaces: vast cyan sky-glass field at left
warm brick wall with stacked dark apertures
receding asphalt seam and dashed lane trace
tiny pale pinhole in open sky

detected_objects.label: hero cream vertical marquee slab
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The tall weathered cream enamel sign face is clearly visible, with chipped edges, red block marks, a blue circular top medallion, and vertical slab geometry.

detected_objects.label: hero persistent glass plate field
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A dominant uninterrupted cyan-blue field occupies the left and upper plate, visibly textured like aged glass or screen surface, bounded by the marquee edge and distant street horizon.

detected_objects.label: architect handoff road seam
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A thin receding lane/seam trace runs through the lower road surface toward the center distance, visible as a pale directional line broken by asphalt texture.

detected_objects.label: kanban brick-slot aperture
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A stair-stepped cluster of dark rectangular brick-wall slots with purple glints appears on the upper right brick spine, reading as stacked apertures rather than UI cards.

detected_objects.label: brains-stack sign shadow
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A deep black vertical gutter sits immediately behind the cream marquee, forming a strong hidden contour and depth layer against the brick wall.

detected_objects.label: published-algorithm pinhole

complexity_assessment.rationale: The plate keeps a strong minimal left-field silence, but the right side carries dense brick, marquee, pixel sign, figures, slots, and lights. It remains usable, though the aperture cluster and tilted sign add visual load.

mapping_note: Package assembly filled unmapped source pockets from planned artifact surfaces because plate inspection returned too few detected objects.
